name: The Reed Gallery
notes: Gate I beat two: DEVELOPMENT. Level 1 taught each verb in isolation; this one introduces exactly one new thing - a locked door that is NOT the exit. Everything else is deliberately recycled from level 1 so there is only ever one new idea in front of the player at a time (spec section 15). The stakes and the guardian both return, but now the guardian is above the player and visible from the floor before she commits to the climb. QA: the climb was first authored as a staircase and that was wrong. A stair tile placed inside the walkway row drops its surface a full tile below that walkway where the two meet, which both trapped the player in the notch and walled off everything to the left of it. Vertical movement is a ladder; stairs belong at the edges of a room where nothing has to walk past them. The whole room is one screen and the gallery is fully visible from the start position, so the door can be seen to be shut long before the player learns what opens it.

treasures.note: Off the critical path: it sits past the foot of the ladder, so taking it costs a walk back.
Beyond the door, on the way to the gate. A reward for opening it rather than a detour.

required_objects.note: On the gallery, between where the ladder arrives and the door it opens. The player meets the shut door first only if they walk straight past it, which most will not - and that is fine, because the lesson is what a door IS.

doors.note: The first door in the game that is not the level exit. It is the whole point of the level: a barrier inside the room, opened by something you carry.

enemies.note: Starts walking away from where the ladder arrives, so the player is never dropped straight into it. Contained between the shut door and the east wall while the door is closed. Visible from the ground floor for the whole climb.

optional_routes.label: walk past the ladder for t_bead_2, then come back

solution: From the start at (1,10) walk right along the floor, taking t_bead_1 at (3,10). A single tile of reed stakes sits at (6,10); jump it from (5,10) to (7,10), which is also the checkpoint. t_bead_2 lies further right at (14,10) and costs a walk back. The ladder stands at column 13 and runs from the floor up through the gallery at row 6, stopping flush with its surface, so step off left onto (12,5). A guardian patrols the gallery; it starts walking away from the arrival and is contained between the shut door and the east wall, so it can be watched from the floor below before committing. Take k_gallery at (9,5), continue left, and the door at (5,5) opens on contact once the key is held. t_seal_2 sits just beyond it at (2,5). The gate at (1,5) unseals with the same key.
